mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 1% for two consecutive months reduces near-term discounting of corporate earnings, lowering the present value of future cash flows and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1% and remains above for ≥2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat despite the policy signal, with p-value > 0.05 in a backtest.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in hourly wage growth (indirect via UNRATE) weakens consumer demand and corporate hiring confidence, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases over the next 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05) during similar labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1,200K for two consecutive months indicates accelerating building activity, which raises expectations of economic recovery and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite the trend in HOUST, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply-side weakness, reducing market liquidity and increasing volatility that precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or the effect is not detectable in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly rises by more than 0.3% in a month, it suggests inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to signal future rate hikes that compress equity valuations and drive negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or the effect is not statistically significant in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% and a rise in monthly payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100K indicates a strong labor market, which boosts investor confidence and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS > 100K for the current month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the interaction is not statistically detectable.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (implied via negative change in GDPC1) for three consecutive months suggests weakening consumer demand, which lowers growth expectations and is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or the signal is not significant in a rolling window test.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in the 10-year Treasury yield (implied via FEDFUNDS behavior) below 1.5% for 10 consecutive trading days reduces real discount rates, supporting higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive or the yield channel is not empirically supported.
